zones.title: LLM telemetry harvester
zones.body: Every minute: list the last 30 executions (metadata only), keep the finished ones of the intake and the two agents that have no llm_call rows yet, fetch those one at a time with run data (at most 10), and insert one step_log row per model call (tokens in/out, duration), idempotent per execution, node and run. The dashboard sums them per order. Never pull execution data in bulk: 100 full executions in one call OOM-killed the lab. Production: the same llm.tokens.* attributes leave n8n over OpenTelemetry; this workflow is the PoC and chargeback path.
